```{r}
## dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.toxlet.2014.01.007
library(tidyverse)
library(deSolve)

# Define the differential equations
pbpk_model <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # Differential equations for each compartment
    dPlasma = Qgut * Gut/Kp_gut + Qliver * Liver/Kp_liver + Qkidney * Kidney/Kp_kidney + Qbrain * Brain/Kp_brain + Qlungs * Lungs/Kp_lungs - Qheart * Plasma
    dGut = intake - Qgut * Gut/Kp_gut
    dLiver = Qgut * Gut/Kp_gut - Qliver * Liver/Kp_liver
    dFat = Qfat * free * Plasma - Fat/Kp_fat
    dKidney = Qkidney * free * Plasma - Kidney/Kp_kidney - Tm * Kidney/(Kt + Kidney)
    dBrain = Qbrain * free * Plasma - Brain/Kp_brain
    dLungs = Qlungs * free * Plasma - Lungs/Kp_lungs

    # Return the rate of change
    return(list(c(dPlasma, dGut, dLiver, dFat, dKidney, dBrain, dLungs)))
  })
}

# Initial state values for each compartment
state <- c(Plasma = 0, Gut = 0, Liver = 0, Fat = 0, Kidney = 0, Brain = 0, Lungs = 0)

# Parameters including the extracted values
parameters <- list(Qgut = 56.47, Qliver = 58.97, Qfat = 19.03, Qkidney = 55.22, Qbrain = 10.61, Qlungs = 10.92, Qheart = 312,
                   Kp_fat = 0.47, Kp_liver = 1.03, Kp_kidney = 1.17, Kp_gut = 1.0, Kp_brain = 0.17, Kp_lungs = 1.27,
                   free = 0.03, Tm = 86.0, Kt = 0.0176, intake = 0.01) # Assume an intake rate, adjust as needed

# Time points for the simulation
time <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)

# Solve the model
# Solve the model
out <- ode(y = state, times = time, func = pbpk_model, parms = parameters)
out_df <- as.data.frame(out)

# Convert time to a long format for ggplot
out_long <- reshape2::melt(out_df, id.vars = "time")

# Plot the results using ggplot2
ggplot(data = out_long, aes(x = time, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "PBPK Model Simulation for PFOS and PFOA",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Concentration") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = out_long, aes(x = time, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "PBPK Model Simulation for PFOS and PFOA",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Concentration") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~variable)


```

## New model for each compound
```{r}

library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Define the parameters dataframe with cardiac output values for each compartment
parameters_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Qgut", "Qliver", "Qfat", "Qkidney", "Qbrain", "Qlungs", "Qrest_of_body",
                "Kp_gut_PFAS", "Kp_liver_PFAS", "Kp_fat_PFAS", "Kp_kidney_PFAS", "Kp_brain_PFAS", "Kp_lungs_PFAS", "Kp_rest_of_body_PFAS",
                "Kp_gut_PFOA", "Kp_liver_PFOA", "Kp_fat_PFOA", "Kp_kidney_PFOA", "Kp_brain_PFOA", "Kp_lungs_PFOA", "Kp_rest_of_body_PFOA",
                "free_PFAS", "free_PFOA", "intake_PFAS", "intake_PFOA"),
  Value = c(56.47, 58.97, 19.03, 55.22, 10.61, 10.92, 64.27,
            1.03, 2.67, 0.33, 1.26, 0.26, 0.15, 1,
            1.03, 2.20, 0.04, 1.05, 0.01, 0.15, 1,
            0.03, 0.03, 1, 1)
)

# Define the PBPK model function incorporating all compartments
pbpk_model <- function(time, state, parameters_df) {
  params <- setNames(parameters_df$Value, parameters_df$Parameter)
  
  with(as.list(c(state, params)), {
    # Differential equations for PFAS
    dPlasma_PFAS = Qgut * Gut_PFAS/Kp_gut_PFAS + Qliver * Liver_PFAS/Kp_liver_PFAS + Qkidney * Kidney_PFAS/Kp_kidney_PFAS + Qbrain * Brain_PFAS/Kp_brain_PFAS + Qlungs * Lungs_PFAS/Kp_lungs_PFAS + Qrest_of_body * Rest_of_body_PFAS/Kp_rest_of_body_PFAS - Plasma_PFAS + intake_PFAS
    dGut_PFAS = Qgut * (Plasma_PFAS - Gut_PFAS/Kp_gut_PFAS)
    dLiver_PFAS = Qliver * (Plasma_PFAS - Liver_PFAS/Kp_liver_PFAS)
    dFat_PFAS = Qfat * (Plasma_PFAS - Fat_PFAS/Kp_fat_PFAS)
    dKidney_PFAS = Qkidney * (Plasma_PFAS - Kidney_PFAS/Kp_kidney_PFAS)
    dBrain_PFAS = Qbrain * (Plasma_PFAS - Brain_PFAS/Kp_brain_PFAS)
    dLungs_PFAS = Qlungs * (Plasma_PFAS - Lungs_PFAS/Kp_lungs_PFAS)
    dRest_of_body_PFAS = Qrest_of_body * (Plasma_PFAS - Rest_of_body_PFAS/Kp_rest_of_body_PFAS)

    # Differential equations for PFOA
    dPlasma_PFOA = Qgut * Gut_PFOA/Kp_gut_PFOA + Qliver * Liver_PFOA/Kp_liver_PFOA + Qkidney * Kidney_PFOA/Kp_kidney_PFOA + Qbrain * Brain_PFOA/Kp_brain_PFOA + Qlungs * Lungs_PFOA/Kp_lungs_PFOA + Qrest_of_body * Rest_of_body_PFOA/Kp_rest_of_body_PFOA - Plasma_PFOA + intake_PFOA
    dGut_PFOA = Qgut * (Plasma_PFOA - Gut_PFOA/Kp_gut_PFOA)
    dLiver_PFOA = Qliver * (Plasma_PFOA - Liver_PFOA/Kp_liver_PFOA)
    dFat_PFOA = Qfat * (Plasma_PFOA - Fat_PFOA/Kp_fat_PFOA)
    dKidney_PFOA = Qkidney * (Plasma_PFOA - Kidney_PFOA/Kp_kidney_PFOA)
    dBrain_PFOA = Qbrain * (Plasma_PFOA - Brain_PFOA/Kp_brain_PFOA)
    dLungs_PFOA = Qlungs * (Plasma_PFOA - Lungs_PFOA/Kp_lungs_PFOA)
    dRest_of_body_PFOA = Qrest_of_body * (Plasma_PFOA - Rest_of_body_PFOA/Kp_rest_of_body_PFOA)

    # Return the rate of change
    return(list(c(dPlasma_PFAS, dGut_PFAS, dLiver_PFAS, dFat_PFAS, dKidney_PFAS, dBrain_PFAS, dLungs_PFAS, dRest_of_body_PFAS, 
                  dPlasma_PFOA, dGut_PFOA, dLiver_PFOA, dFat_PFOA, dKidney_PFOA, dBrain_PFOA, dLungs_PFOA, dRest_of_body_PFOA)))
  })
}

# Define initial states for each compartment for both PFAS and PFOA
state <- c(Plasma_PFAS = 0, Gut_PFAS = 0, Liver_PFAS = 0, Fat_PFAS = 0, Kidney_PFAS = 0, Brain_PFAS = 0, Lungs_PFAS = 0, Rest_of_body_PFAS = 0, 
           Plasma_PFOA = 0, Gut_PFOA = 0, Liver_PFOA = 0, Fat_PFOA = 0, Kidney_PFOA = 0, Brain_PFOA = 0, Lungs_PFOA = 0, Rest_of_body_PFOA = 0)

# Define time points for the simulation
time <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)

# Solve the model
out <- ode(y = state, times = time, func = pbpk_model, parms = parameters_df)

# Convert to data frame and melt for ggplot2
out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
out_long <- melt(out_df, id.vars = "time")

# Plot with ggplot2, including facet_wrap for both compounds
# Adjust the data frame for clearer facetting by compound type
out_long$Compound <- ifelse(grepl("PFAS", out_long$variable), "PFAS", "PFOA")
out_long$Compartment <- gsub("_PFAS|_PFOA", "", out_long$variable)

# Plot with ggplot2, including facet_wrap for each compound
ggplot(data = out_long, aes(x = time, y = value, color = Compartment)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "PBPK Model Simulation Over Time", x = "Time", y = "Concentration") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ Compound, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")



```
